headline: Executive order on getting federal agencies to use commercial, cost-effective options when they buy goods and services.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with how federal agencies buy things through contracts. It appears to push agencies toward commercial products and services that are already on the market, and toward options that cost less. No summary was provided, so the specific rules and requirements are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and their purchasing staff
who_it_affects.how: They may face new direction on choosing commercial, lower-cost options when they sign contracts.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that sell to the federal government
who_it_affects.how: The kinds of products and services the government chooses to buy could shift, which may affect which businesses win contracts.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 15, 2025; the source does not give a specific effective date.
